feature_definitions.name: bayesian_place_rate
feature_definitions.description: Place rate (top 3) smoothed with Bayesian prior (Beta(3,3) prior ~ 50% base rate)

feature_definitions.name: bayesian_win_rate
feature_definitions.description: Win rate smoothed with Bayesian prior (Beta(1,5) prior ~ 17% base rate for 6-runner races). Prevents noisy estimates from small samples.

feature_definitions.name: best_adjusted_time_last10
feature_definitions.description: Fastest going-adjusted time in last 10 races — the dog's ceiling performance

feature_definitions.name: best_adjusted_time_last10_same_dist
feature_definitions.description: Fastest going-adjusted time in last 10 races at the same distance

feature_definitions.name: career_runs
feature_definitions.description: Total number of races in career

feature_definitions.name: current_race_sp
feature_definitions.description: The starting price (decimal odds) for this specific race. The single strongest predictor of race outcomes — represents the market's collective assessment of each dog's chances.

feature_definitions.name: day_of_week
feature_definitions.description: Day of week as integer (0=Monday, 6=Sunday). Different days may have different race quality, field strength, or track conditions.

feature_definitions.name: day_of_week_cos
feature_definitions.description: Cosine encoding of day of week — paired with sin encoding for full cyclical representation.

feature_definitions.name: day_of_week_sin
feature_definitions.description: Sine encoding of day of week for cyclical representation — avoids hard boundary between Sunday and Monday.

feature_definitions.name: days_since_last_race
feature_definitions.description: Rest days since last race — freshness indicator

feature_definitions.name: days_since_last_win
feature_definitions.description: Days since the dog last won a race

feature_definitions.name: ewm_adjusted_time_last10
feature_definitions.description: Exponentially weighted mean going-adjusted time — combines recency with going normalization

feature_definitions.name: ewm_finish_time_last10
feature_definitions.description: Exponentially weighted mean finish time — recent races weighted more heavily. Alpha=0.5.

feature_definitions.name: ewm_position_last10
feature_definitions.description: Exponentially weighted mean finish position — recent races weighted more heavily

feature_definitions.name: finish_position_stdev_last5
feature_definitions.description: Standard deviation of finish positions — lower means more predictable

feature_definitions.name: finish_time_trend_last5
feature_definitions.description: Slope of finish time over last 5 races — negative means improving

feature_definitions.name: first_bend_trouble_rate
feature_definitions.description: Fraction of last 10 races with trouble specifically at the first bend

feature_definitions.name: going_win_rate
feature_definitions.description: Win rate on the same going/ground conditions

feature_definitions.name: grade_change
feature_definitions.description: Whether the dog is moving up or down in class. Positive = dropping (easier), negative = stepping up (harder).

feature_definitions.name: improving_form
feature_definitions.description: Whether positions are improving (negative slope = getting better)

feature_definitions.name: mean_adjusted_time_last5
feature_definitions.description: Average going-adjusted finish time over last 5 races. Normalizes for track conditions.

feature_definitions.name: mean_adjusted_time_last5_same_dist
feature_definitions.description: Average going-adjusted finish time over last 5 races at same distance

feature_definitions.name: mean_beaten_dist_last5
feature_definitions.description: Average lengths behind winner — lower is better

feature_definitions.name: mean_finish_time_last5
feature_definitions.description: Average finish time over the dog's last 5 races

feature_definitions.name: mean_finish_time_last5_same_dist
feature_definitions.description: Average finish time over last 5 races at the same distance

feature_definitions.name: mean_position_last5
feature_definitions.description: Average finishing position over last 5 races

feature_definitions.name: mean_sectional_last5
feature_definitions.description: Average early pace (time to first bend)

feature_definitions.name: mean_sp_last5
feature_definitions.description: Average starting price — indicates market assessment

feature_definitions.name: mean_weight_last5
feature_definitions.description: Average racing weight over last 5 races

feature_definitions.name: min_finish_time_last10
feature_definitions.description: Fastest finish time over the dog's last 10 races

feature_definitions.name: optimal_rest_window
feature_definitions.description: Binary: 1.0 if 7-14 days since last race (optimal), 0.0 otherwise. Based on research showing greyhounds peak with 7-14 day rest intervals.

feature_definitions.name: place_rate_last10
feature_definitions.description: Percentage of top-3 finishes in last 10 races

feature_definitions.name: race_month_cos
feature_definitions.description: Cosine encoding of race month — paired with sin encoding so the model can learn any seasonal pattern without discontinuity at year boundaries.

feature_definitions.name: race_month_sin
feature_definitions.description: Sine encoding of race month for cyclical seasonality — captures time-of-year effects (e.g. track conditions, daylight, temperature) without a hard boundary between December and January.

feature_definitions.name: races_in_last_30_days
feature_definitions.description: Number of races in the past 30 days — workload indicator

feature_definitions.name: rest_category
feature_definitions.description: Categorized rest: 1=short (<5 days), 2=quick turnaround (5-6), 3=optimal (7-14), 4=freshened (15-28), 5=layoff (29+). Encoded as integer.

feature_definitions.name: runs_at_distance
feature_definitions.description: Number of career races at this distance

feature_definitions.name: runs_at_track
feature_definitions.description: Number of races at this track

feature_definitions.name: stdev_finish_time_last5
feature_definitions.description: Standard deviation of finish time — lower means more consistent

feature_definitions.name: track_distance_affinity
feature_definitions.description: Average position at this track and distance combo — lower is better

feature_definitions.name: trap_place_rate_at_track
feature_definitions.description: Historical top-3 rate for this trap at this track

feature_definitions.name: trap_win_rate_at_track
feature_definitions.description: Historical win rate for this trap number at this specific track

feature_definitions.name: trouble_rate_last10
feature_definitions.description: Fraction of last 10 races where the dog encountered trouble (checked, bumped, crowded, fell, hampered). Higher = more unlucky.

feature_definitions.name: win_rate_last10
feature_definitions.description: Percentage of wins in last 10 races

feature_definitions.name: win_rate_same_track
feature_definitions.description: Win rate at this track across all races

feature_definitions.name: win_rate_same_trap
feature_definitions.description: Win rate from this trap number
